descriptionModule.briefSummary: A multicenter, randomized, double-blind, phase Ⅳ study to evaluate the long-term efficacy and safety of Pitavastatin/Ezetimibe and Pitavastatin in patients with hypercholesterolemia with elevated triglycerides
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: A multicenter study to evaluate efficacy and safety

maskingInfo.maskingDescription: To maintain the double-blind, a double-dummy method was used where participants received both an active tablet and a matching placebo of the comparator

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with hypercholesterolemia
* Patients diagnosed with metabolic syndrome or type 2 diabetes mellitus, and presenting with elevated LDL-C

Exclusion Criteria:

* New-onset acute cardio-cerebrovascular disease
* Severe hepatic impairment
* Active liver disease

identificationModule.briefTitle: Long-term Comparison of Pitavastatin/Ezetimibe and Pitavastatin in Patients With Hypercholesterolemia and Elevated Triglycerides
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Multicenter Study to Evaluate Efficacy and Safety

primaryOutcomes.description: The unit of measure is percentage (%). The percentage change is calculated as: \[(Value at Week 8 - Value at Baseline) / Value at Baseline\] \* 100
primaryOutcomes.measure: Percentage change from baseline in LDL Cholesterol at Week 8 after the first dose of study treatment

secondaryOutcomes.description: Change = (Value at Week 8, 24, or 52) - (Value at Baseline), Unit of measure: mg/dL
secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change from baseline in HDL Cholesterol at Weeks 8, 24, and 52 after the first dose of study treatment

secondaryOutcomes.description: The NLFS is a calculated score used to estimate liver fat content. The change is calculated as (Value at Week 24 or 52) - (Value at Baseline).
secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change from baseline in Non-alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease Liver Fat Score (NLFS) at Weeks 24 and 52
